items.prompt: A 3-digit number has tens digit 0. Its hundreds digit is 3 times its ones digit. Its digits add up to 8. What is the number?
hints: The ones digit is 1 block. The hundreds digit is 3 blocks.
The digits add up to 4 blocks, because the tens digit is 0.
4 blocks make 8.
items.explanation: The hundreds digit is 3 blocks, the ones digit is 1 block and the tens digit is 0. 4 blocks make 8, so 1 block is 2. The number is 602.

solution.say: The hundreds digit is 3 blocks, the ones digit is 1 block and the tens digit is 0.

items.prompt: The digits of a 3-digit number are all different and add up to 10. What is the biggest such number?
hints: Put the biggest possible digit in the hundreds place.
With 9 in the hundreds place, the other two digits add up to 1.
Use the bigger of those digits in the tens place.
items.explanation: The hundreds digit is at most 9. The other two digits then add up to 1, so they are 1 and 0. The biggest number puts 1 before 0: 910.

solution.say: The hundreds digit is at most 9.
The other two digits then add up to 1, so they are 1 and 0.

items.prompt: Use the digits 0, 5 and 7 once each. How many different 3-digit numbers can you make?
hints: A 3-digit number cannot start with 0.
List the numbers that start with 5.
Then list the numbers that start with 7.
items.explanation: Starting with 5: 507 and 570. Starting with 7: 705 and 750. That makes 4 numbers.

items.prompt: Which of these numbers is 400 when rounded to the nearest hundred?
hints: Numbers from 350 to 449 round to 400.
Check each number against 350 and 449.
Which number is in that range?
items.explanation: 351 is between 350 and 449, so it rounds to 400. The others round to 300 or 500.

solution.say: 351 is between 350 and 449, so it rounds to 400.

items.prompt: How many whole numbers are there between 398 and 405?
hints: Do not count 398 or 405.
The first number is 399.
List them up to 404.
items.explanation: The numbers are 399, 400, 401, 402, 403 and 404. That is 6 numbers.

items.prompt: Which number is the closest to 500?
hints: Find how far each number is from 500.
Some numbers are bigger and some are smaller.
Take the smaller number from the bigger number each time.
items.explanation: The distances from 500 are 22, 23, 11, 12 and 5. The smallest distance is 5, so 495 is the closest.

solution.say: The smallest distance is 5, so 495 is the closest.

items.prompt: Is the product 17 x 24 x 31 odd or even?

options.why: An even number times any number is even.
The order of multiplying does not change the answer.
Every whole number is odd or even.

hints: Look at each number in the product.
Is any of the numbers even?
An even number multiplied by anything is even.
items.explanation: The number 24 is even. A product with an even number in it is always even.

solution.say: A product with an even number in it is always even.

items.prompt: Write the numbers from 1 to 100. How many times do you write the digit 7?
hints: Count the digit 7 in the ones place and in the tens place.
Ones place: 7, 17, 27 ...
Tens place: 70, 71 ...
items.explanation: The ones place has a 7 in 7, 17, 27, 37, 47, 57, 67, 77, 87 and 97, which is 10. The tens place has a 7 in 70 to 79, which is 10. In all, 10 + 10 = 20.

solution.say: The ones place has a 7 in 7, 17, 27, 37, 47, 57, 67, 77, 87 and 97, which is 10.
The tens place has a 7 in 70 to 79, which is 10.

items.prompt: How many numbers from 100 to 199 have digits that add up to 5?
hints: The hundreds digit is 1.
The tens and ones digits must add up to 4.
items.explanation: The tens and ones digits add up to 4. The numbers are 104, 113, 122, 131 and 140. That is 5 numbers.

solution.say: The tens and ones digits add up to 4.

items.prompt: Swap the hundreds digit and the ones digit of 742. How much smaller is the new number?
hints: Swap the first and last digits.
The new number is 247.
Take 247 away from 742.
items.explanation: Swapping the first and last digits of 742 gives 247. The new number is 742 - 247 = 495 smaller.

solution.say: Swapping the first and last digits of 742 gives 247.

items.prompt: The digits of a 2-digit number add up to 12. The tens digit is 2 more than the ones digit. What is the number?
hints: The tens and ones digits are 2 apart.
Their total is 12.
Find two numbers that are 2 apart and add up to 12.
items.explanation: Two numbers that are 2 apart and add up to 12 are 7 and 5. The tens digit is the bigger one, so the number is 75.

solution.say: Two numbers that are 2 apart and add up to 12 are 7 and 5.
The tens digit is the bigger one, so the number is 75.
